title: Police, paramedics sued after man dies
article: The family of a man who died two years ago after being held in police custody is suing the RCMP and the paramedics who gave him medical treatment.

Ian Alexander Young, 55, was found by paramedics in October 2008 lying half on the sidewalk and half on the road in Maple Ridge. They decided Young did not need to be taken to hospital and instead asked for help from RCMP, according to a statement of claim filed in B.C. Supreme Court.
Police also decided that there was no need for Young to be hospitalized, the suit says.
He was taken to the drunk tank at the Ridge Meadows RCMP detachment. Young -- who had been drinking with friends, though not heavily, earlier in the evening -- was left for the night in the cell.
The following day, he was unresponsive and was taken to hospital. He died the next day as a result of a brain injury, the lawsuit says.
